Pipes should be able to be built and destroyed, along with all their
components (valves, connectors, vents, etc.).
maybe another good use for the autolathe? add metal, get 'valve components' ?

Maybe make it like tables.  You can make 'pipe parts' from metal, which then can be 
converted into pipes in the direction/angle of your choosing.  For valves and such I 
guess we could use the autolathe for that?
